sources.title: Future schemes
sources.verified_claim: Enfield records future housing schemes with scheme-specific tender, consent and restart milestones; for the Exeter Road example a planning resolution and intended autumn 2026 restart remain delivery-stage information rather than proof for the sample parcel.

sources.title: Enfield withdraws from New Town process following change in leadership
sources.verified_claim: Enfield formally withdrew support for the government New Town programme including Crews Hill and Vicarage Farm/Green Belt proposals while reaffirming a brownfield-first housing and town-centre regeneration approach; this is a material policy counter-signal.

sources.title: 100 Day plan for Havering restores stability to the Council
sources.verified_claim: Havering's new administration set a 100-day programme focused on stabilisation, governance, finances, services and a longer-term vision including homes for local people; it is a strategic governance signal, not parcel delivery.

sources.title: Planning approval secured for Waterloo and Queen Street Site in Romford
sources.verified_claim: Havering reports approval for Blocks 9 and 10 in the Waterloo and Queen Street regeneration, with the first phase delivering more than 107 affordable homes and public/community space; approval is site specific and not evidence for the sample parcel.

sources.title: Angel Way development approved at Strategic Planning Committee
sources.verified_claim: Havering reports committee approval for 106 homes at Angel Way in Romford, with further detailed design work to follow; committee approval and pipeline activity are not treated as construction completion.

sources.title: Lambeth: Shaping the borough's future
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth announced its new Local Plan process with September 2026 scoping engagement and an April 2029 adoption aim, framing future housing, infrastructure and environmental growth; the plan is not yet adopted.

sources.title: Programme information
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's New Homes Programme maps and monitors council-owned site delivery, balances site opportunities, constraints, subsidy and financial risk, and uses a site-by-site approach; programme membership does not establish delivery for the sample parcel.

sources.title: Estate renewal
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth reports completed first renewal phases with 105 new social-rent homes at three estates while other estates remain in options appraisal; completed and appraisal-stage projects are kept distinct.
